decisions.reason: Ridgehaven staff-access isolation is already fully represented by the candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE Event; the booking-specific modification requires no additional change.
The existing rule that each location has its own payment processing and setup already covers Ridgehaven; the source does not change that payment-isolation state.
The candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE Event already records Ridgehaven's separate customer database, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
The candidate already has a message-55 MODIFY explicitly adding Ridgehaven analytics isolation, and that Event is complete for this source.
Ridgehaven gift-card isolation is already fully established by the candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE Event.
The current candidate state already requires separate Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley payouts supported by separate Wix and payment setups; message 55 reaffirms rather than changes that state.
The existing account model already requires a separate Wix account for every location, which includes Ridgehaven; the source adds no new account-model state.
The source does not change calendar isolation or placement; booking isolation does not itself entail a new calendar requirement.
The candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE Event already records Ridgehaven membership isolation, so no additional Event is necessary.
The existing location-website model already gives each location its own Wix website; the source's Ridgehaven account and booking details do not alter that model.
The candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE Event already captures the coming-soon state and the transition to enabling booking at opening.
The booking-isolation modification does not change VIP signup behavior, and the message-55 VIP signup requirement is already represented by its INTRODUCE Event.
